HomePage.heroHeadline: Run your school from one place.
HomePage.heroSubtext: Attendance, exams, fees, and communication for admins, teachers, students, and parents, in one bilingual system.
HomePage.featuresSubtext: Six connected modules, one login per person.
HomePage.attendanceBody: Take attendance by classroom and track patterns across the term.
HomePage.examsBody: Build exams, record results, and publish grades to students and parents.
HomePage.feesBody: Charge, collect, and reconcile tuition and other fees per student.
HomePage.libraryBody: Catalog resources and let students and parents borrow online.
HomePage.structureBody: Organize stages, grades, classrooms, and academic years.
HomePage.rolesSubtext: Each role gets its own sign-in and its own view of the system.
HomePage.roleAdminDesc: Manage students, staff, fees, and settings.
HomePage.roleTeacherDesc: Take attendance, grade exams, run your classroom.
HomePage.roleStudentDesc: See exams, grades, attendance, and fees.
HomePage.roleParentDesc: Follow your child's progress and pay fees.
HomePage.howHeading: Up and running in three steps
HomePage.step1Body: Add stages, grades, classrooms, and the current academic year.
HomePage.step2Body: Bring in teachers, students, and parents with role-based accounts.
HomePage.step3Body: Take attendance, run exams, collect fees, and track it all.
HomePage.finalCtaHeading: Ready to bring your school online?
HomePage.finalCtaSubtext: Create an account and set up your school in minutes.
HomePage.footerTagline: One system for your whole school.
